title: Default Top Perspective Two Window Layout
description: Make puzzle 3d and aggregator use a two-window layout by default: Top (left 1/3), Perspective (right 2/3). Honor instanceId and templateId from app default layouts so each pane seeds the correct projection.
summary:
Follow-up: Top orthographic pane was seeded with zoom=50 and the shared perspective camera target, so the reference image appeared massively zoomed-in and off-frame.

World3dHost now frames pending projection templates to scene content (instances + visible references): target is the content center, and orthographic zoom is derived from the live viewport size (drei/R3F pixel frustum). A one-shot WorldProjectionContentFrame refines zoom once the pane size is known. Helpers: worldSceneContentBounds, worldProjectionOrthoZoom, frameWorldProjectionPose.

Tests: infinite-world-r3f framing cases (100/100), framework-renderer-react (204/204).
